name: Faro Airport

runway.v: one runway, 10/28, 2,490 m long and 45 m wide

hours.v: aerodrome open 06:00–24:00 UTC (05:00–23:00 UTC in summer), i.e. 06:00 to midnight local; extension to 01:00 possible if requested by 23:30
hours.quote: * Aerodrome OPS HR extension will be considered until 01:00 (00:00) of the next day, if requested until 23:30 (22:30),

curfew.v: by Portuguese law no landings or take-offs between 00:00 and 06:00 UTC (23:00–05:00 UTC in summer), i.e. midnight to 06:00 local; Faro is not on the list of airports with the night exception regime
curfew.quote: On Airports and/or Aerodromes landing and/or take-off is forbidden by Law between 00:00 (23:00) and 06:00 (05:00)

slots.v: airport slots are requested as set out in GEN 1.2
slots.quote: For airport slots request see GEN 1.2 ENTRY, TRANSIT AND DEPARTURE OF AIRCRAFT

handling.v: every GA/BA operator must use a listed ground handler; the AIP names Groundforce, Portway, Elitesky, Omni, Safeport, Sky Valet, Groundlink and PTS (Ryanair self-handles)
handling.quote: All GA/BA operators must be assisted by one ground handler as specified in LPFR AD 2.23 item 2 Handling Services.

max_aircraft.v: GA/BA aircraft preferably use stands 201–213; non-based aircraft may not park more than 72 hours
max_aircraft.quote: all aircraft other than those based at Faro, are not allowed to park more than 72 hours.

fuel.v: fuelling 08:00–24:00 UTC (07:00–23:00 UTC in summer), other times on request with a surcharge
fuel.quote: Fuelling 08:00-24:00 (07:00-23:00). Other times on request with surcharge

notes: Times: the Portuguese AIP gives UTC with summer UTC in brackets; Portugal is UTC+0 in winter and UTC+1 in summer, so both give the same local times (aerodrome 06:00–24:00, night ban 00:00–06:00). Fuelling local = 08:00–24:00. AD 2.21 only refers to AD 1.1.5/1.1.6 and gives no airport-specific night times. The runway width/length line sits next to RWY 10; RWY 28 is the other end of the same runway. PPR is mentioned only for engine runs and unserviceable-aircraft start-up, not for arrivals.
